title: Festive Playlist and Mood Boost
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=mood:entry OR sourcetype=festive:lights)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(eval(if(sourcetype=="mood:entry",mood_score,null()))) as mood, max(eval(if(lights_on="true",1,0))) as festive_on by _time
| eval festive=if(festive_on=1,"lights on","lights off")
| stats avg(mood) as avg_mood by festive
description: Compares your mood on days the festive lights were on versus off, testing whether the decorations really cheer you up.
value: It is a bit of fun, but a genuine mood lift from decorations is a lovely reason to put them up early.
implementation: Join mood with festive-light state in `index=personal`; compare average mood by whether the lights were on.
visualization: Bar chart of average mood with festive lights on versus off.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether your mood is better on days the festive lights are on, a cheerful bit of fun.
